body.statement: Under the balanced rank-one one-chart assumptions, there are constants \(c_1,C_1,C_2<\infty\), depending only on \(\alpha,\mu,\kappa,s_-,s_+\), such that, uniformly over \(\vartheta_n\in\Theta_n\), \[\mathbb E[\mathring q_{\alpha,n}]\le C_1\sigma\sqrt n,\qquad \mathbb E[(\widehat q_{\alpha,n}-\mathring q_{\alpha,n})_+]\le C_1\sigma\sqrt n,\qquad \mathbb E[\widehat q_{\alpha,n}]\le C_2\sigma\sqrt n.\] On \(\mathcal G_n\cap\mathcal F_n^c\), \(\widehat\delta_n\asymp s_-n\), \(\widehat M_n=O(s_+n)\), and therefore \[\mathscr R_n^{(2)}\le C_2\frac{\sigma^2}{s_-}\le C_2\sigma\sqrt n,\qquad \mathbb E[\mathscr R_n^{(2)}\mathbf 1\{\mathcal F_n^c\}]\le C_2\sigma\sqrt n.\] Moreover, for all sufficiently large even \(n\), \[\Pr(\mathcal F_n)\le C_1\exp\{-c_1s_-^2n/\sigma^2\}\le C_2\frac{\sigma}{s_+n},\qquad s_+n^{3/2}\Pr(\mathcal F_n)\le C_2\sigma\sqrt n.\] The first display separately bounds the exact conditional Gaussian term and its finite-simulation inflation. The other displays follow from the large population chart gap of order \(s_-n\), a Gaussian operator-norm tail evaluated at that gap, the stability test \(\widehat\delta_n\ge4\tau_n\), and the homogeneous identity \(\mathscr R_n^{(2)}=C_0\tau_n^2(\widehat\delta_n^{-1}+\widehat M_n\widehat\delta_n^{-2}+\widehat M_n^2\widehat\delta_n^{-3})\). Thus synchronization, Monte Carlo calibration, Taylor remainder, and fallback contributions each have order at most \(\sigma\sqrt n\) without cancellation.
body.justification: A termwise benchmark audit rules out a formally honest but diameter-scale expected radius.
body.gap: Neither scalar staggered-panel inference nor Frobenius residual theory audits conditional nuclear quantiles, nonlinear remainder, simulation, and fallback on one common scale.
body.consumer: The benchmark certificate and two-sided minimax theorem use these four bounds without cancellation.
